componentName.description: Component name (e.g., "Button", "AnalyticalTable"). Case-insensitive. Must match a component from @ui5/webcomponents-react, @ui5/webcomponents-react-charts, or @ui5/webcomponents-ai-react.

name: get_component_api

availableComponents.description: List of all valid component names (only present on not_found errors)

cssParts.description: CSS ::part() selectors for shadow DOM styling

docUrl.description: Link to upstream documentation for complex behavioral concepts (e.g. layout algorithms)

error.description: Error message if component not found

errorType.description: Semantic error type for programmatic handling

isAbstract.description: True for abstract components (marked @abstract): they render into a parent’s DOM, not their own shadow root. When interacting in a real browser (tests), target the node returned by getDomRef() rather than the host placeholder. See the "Testing" knowledge-base section.

props.description: Component props with types, descriptions, and eventDetail

subTypeDocs.description: Additional documentation for complex prop types (e.g. AnalyticalTable column definition)

title: Component API Reference
